name: research-skills
description: Claude Code plugins for academic research and development: literature search, grant writing and review, manuscript preparation, figures, presentations, project lifecycle management, and neuroinformatics

plugins.name: project
plugins.description: Project lifecycle toolkit: initialization (with ADR scaffold and optional GitHub label set), rule/config updates, epic/sprint workflow, CI/CD scaffolding, Docker packaging, security auditing, and document processing

plugins.name: grant
plugins.description: Grant proposal toolkit: NIH/NSF writing with mechanism-specific templates, structured review with scoring criteria, and figure quality assurance

plugins.name: manuscript
plugins.description: Academic manuscript toolkit: literature review (multi-phase citation-traceable + single-pass thematic), peer review, writing, journal-specific formatting for submission, and humanizer pass to remove AI-writing tells

plugins.name: opencite
plugins.description: Academic literature search, citation management, PDF retrieval, identifier conversion, and BibTeX export

plugins.name: figures
plugins.description: Publication-quality figures plugin. Seven skills + one QA agent: scientific-figure (svgutils composer with font validation; Inkscape/cairosvg export); transparent-icons (flat scientific icons via Codex CLI or OpenAI Images API); svg-figure (schematic authoring with consistency guidelines); svg-primitives (mm-precise SVG builder in Python: auto-fit boxes, tangent-correct arrows on straight/cubic/orthogonal routes, multi-waypoint paths, brackets/annotations/groups, layered z-order); ai-full-figure (AI substrate + programmatic label/arrow/scale-bar overlay); plot-styling (library decision tree + SciencePlots recipes for Nature/IEEE/Science/Cell/PNAS/APS); figure-qa agent (type-dispatching QA across SVG/raster/plot-script with strict programmatic-vs-VLM separation).

plugins.name: presentation
plugins.description: Presentation builder: create interactive Reveal.js presentations from JSON with Mermaid diagrams, LaTeX math, code highlighting, and animated reveals

plugins.name: neuroinformatics
plugins.description: Neuroscience data standards and experiment design: BIDS conversion/validation, HED annotation, and PsychoPy experiment scaffolding
